schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX));
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_action ON Communication(comm_action);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_channelid ON Communication(comm_channelid);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payload ON Communication(payload);
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT TOP ({row_count}) 'Action' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) % 100, REPLICATE('A', 100) FROM sys.all_objects;

tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate the insert performance issue.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution of comm_channelid with repetitive payload.
